title: Practice 7: с-: down, and together — раз-: apart

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Грозу ___ (сносить / снести — to carry down) к мертвому морю.
exercises.why: **снести́** — **сноси́ть** — to carry down; to carry to. **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Михаил Булгаков, «Мастер и Маргарита».
exercises.context: снести́** — **сноси́ть — to carry down; to carry to.

exercises.q: Со всех сторон ___ (сбежаться / сбегаться — to come running).
exercises.why: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat.. **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)** — Divergent movement in various directions from one center. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Преступление и наказание».
exercises.context: Дети сбежались на детскую площадь. — The children ran (from all directions) to the playground. — в / на + acc.; к + dat..

exercises.q: Оживи, ___ (свести / сводить — to lead, to take) их с полотна!
exercises.why: **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. **сойти́сь** — **сходи́ться** — to meet, to come together; to converge, to coalesce. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Михаил Булгаков, «Белая гвардия».
exercises.context: свести́** — **своди́ть — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together.

exercises.q: На музыку ___ (сходиться — to meet, to come together) принято.
exercises.why: **с-** (resultative) — Completed semelfactive movement in opposite directions, there and back; only formed with multidirectional verb of motion — Я сходил в аптеку за лекарством и лёг спать. — I went to the pharmacy for medicine and went to bed. — в / на + acc.; к + dat.. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Идиот».
exercises.context: с- (resultative) — Completed semelfactive movement in opposite directions, there and back; only formed with multidirectional verb of motion — Я сходил в аптеку за лекарством и лёг спать. — I went to the pharmacy for medicine and went to bed. — в / на + acc.;…

exercises.q: Всё с плеч ___ (слететь / слетать — to fly down, to fly away).
exercises.why: The prefix "с-" implies the following meanings: (a) to descend, to go down: Мы съезжаем с горы. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Преступление и наказание».
exercises.context: The prefix "с-" implies the following meanings: (a) to descend, to go down: Мы съезжаем с горы.

exercises.q: Дубовцы осторожно ___ (расползаться — to crawl away) по домам.
exercises.why: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 36, 42.  ·  From Максим Горький, «Экзекуция».
exercises.context: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**.
